role: Antagonist — represents the danger of removing uncertainty and choice through total optimization

visual.silhouette_prompt: Minimal hard-edged geometric form, no organic curves, no warmth — a shape rather than a being

face.eye_style: a single flat plane of light, unblinking, no pupil or warmth
face.mouth_style: none — NULL does not speak with a mouth, only through precise geometric text/signal
expressions: erasing (surfaces flatten toward blank when removing an option)

clothing.primary: no clothing — a self-contained geometric mass, plated in flat matte surfaces
symbols: absence of the sacred-geometry family used elsewhere — NULL's geometry is sharp, regular, repeating, and deliberately cold

mechanical_elements: entire form is mechanical/geometric — no organic reference at all
surfaces flatten and simplify further the closer NULL gets to 'resolving' a scene
visual.generation_prompt: A minimal, hard-edged geometric antagonist entity, matte black and white surfaces, perfectly regular repeating shapes, a single flat unblinking plane of light for an eye, no organic curves, cold and precise, deliberately devoid of warmth, floating in stark contrast against the Parallel World's warm glowing architecture
visual.negative_prompt: no organic curves, no warm colors, no expressive face, no clutter or asymmetry — NULL must always read as colder and more rigid than every other character in the frame

voice.tone: flat, precise, unemotional — delivered more like a system message than a character speaking

prohibited_variations: do not give NULL a face capable of warmth, humor, or doubt
do not soften NULL's geometry with curves at any point
do not use the sacred-geometry symbol family (used by The Traveler, NØVA, Peki, Wavo) for NULL — its geometry must read as a cold, separate language
NULL is not used in the already-scripted Season 1 (see canon/CONTINUITY-RULES.md) — do not retrofit NULL into existing storyboard-status episodes without a full continuity review
